name: 3rdbrain
description: Save anything. Find the right thing when work starts. Cross-runtime skills turn saved material into an organized, indexed, searchable knowledge base on your computer.

plugins.name: 3rdbrain
plugins.description: Turn links, videos, repositories, prompts, articles, screenshots, and notes into a searchable working library. Use /3rdbrain for setup, /3rdbrain:process for curation, /3rdbrain:skills for runtime parity, /3rdbrain:stalecheck for age review, and /3rdbrain:publish for Cloudflare Pages.
